x: Other clubs competing in a four-cornered match were Surrey A.C. and Metropolitan Police A.C. Once again the course was very muddy but Stan Belton of Surrey, revelled in the conditions to come home a good winner.
The next leg to Hickstead, about six miles, is considered as perhaps the stiffest and most important, and Vernon Blowfield was up against Bobby Reid, "Sidney" and Stan Belton (Surrey).
